summary: macOS 802.11ax Target Wake Time causing intermittent IKEv2 rekey failures and VPN drops
description: Issue summary: Over the past 48 hours a subset of macOS laptops (primarily Apple Silicon, macOS 13/14) on the corporate SSID have experienced abrupt VPN disconnects. Symptoms point to IKEv2 rekey negotiation timing out when clients are on 802.11ax APs with Target Wake Time (TWT) enabled. Impact: employees in SF office intermittently lose access to internal services until VPN reconnects (~30s-90s), leading to brief meeting disruptions and terminals hitting timeouts. Scope: ~10-15% of active macOS clients on morning shift; Windows/Linux clients not impacted in observed cases.
steps_to_reproduce: Connect Apple Silicon MacBook (macOS 13/14) to corporate-ssid on AP group 'SF-AX' with TWT enabled.
Establish IKEv2 VPN (corporate profile) and confirm tunnel is UP.
Let machine idle for ~60-120 seconds to allow Wi-Fi power-save cycles (Target Wake Time intervals).
Observe VPN tunnel drop and IKE rekey attempts failing in macOS system log.
Repeat with TWT disabled on AP; issue does not reproduce under same idle conditions.
logs: Mar 10 09:42:11 macbook-pro kernel[0]: ikev2: IKE_SA rekey timed out, peer did not respond
Mar 10 09:42:11 macbook-pro racoon[1234]: IKEv2 rekey: no response after 3 retransmits
Wireshark capture: ESP packets queued/delayed at AP, IKEv2 messages sent but ACKs not received within SA lifetime
Meraki/AP logs show TWT scheduling events at 20s/60s intervals correlated with client idle periods
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: AP power-save (TWT) defers IKE exchanges; macOS IKEv2 implementation treats delayed responses as failures and reinitializes SA, causing tear-down/reconnect loop.
Reproduced in lab with Aruba 9104 and Meraki MR46 running latest stable firmware — behavior appears when TWT enabled and client power-save intervals exceed IKE retransmit timer.
tcpdump on client shows IKEv2 REQUEST sent, no immediate response due to AP holding frames until TWT wake slot; retransmits occur and SA renegotiation fails.
Windows clients use longer keepalive/retry heuristics and are tolerant; Linux strongSwan also tolerant depending on config. macOS default timers appear aggressive for AP TWT delays.
Raised to #internal-netops and #mac-support for coordinated mitigation; created temporary AP config in SF to disable TWT for corporate-ssid.
comments: Sofia Martinez (reporter) 2026-03-10: Noticed ~12 users in morning standup complaining VPN dropped and Slack/Zoom lost connection briefly. Collected syslogs and a packet capture from one repro machine.
Liam Zhang (assignee) 2026-03-10: Looking into wifi/AP interactions. Can you share AP model groups for affected clients? Please keep packet captures coming.

NetOps (Ethan Brooks) 2026-03-11: Reproduced in lab with MR46 and Aruba 9104 when TWT left enabled. Disabling TWT for SSID prevents the rekey failures. Filed change to disable TWT on SF-AX AP group during business hours as mitigation.

SRE (Maya Chen) 2026-03-11: As short-term mitigation we pushed AP change; also proposing increasing IKEv2 retransmit window on gateway and adding UDP keepalive to client profile. Will coordinate change window.
Liam Zhang 2026-03-12: Planned follow-up: update macOS VPN mobileconfig to include Dead Peer Detection/keepalive every 20s for managed devices and open RFC ticket to vendor for Apple behavior notes.
mitigation: NetOps disabled 802.11ax TWT for corporate-ssid on SF AP group during business hours (rolled out 2026-03-11 03:00 UTC). Short-term VPN profile change scheduled: increase IKEv2 retransmit window on edge gateway and add periodic UDP keepalive via managed macOS profile.
next_steps: Coordinate with Security & Device Management to roll macOS mobileconfig update (keepalive/dead-peer-detection) for managed devices.
Work with Wi-Fi vendor (Aruba/Meraki) to get recommendations for combining TWT and latency-sensitive protocols; request firmware guidance.
Monitor VPN stability metrics for affected clients for 72 hours; if stable, close ticket and schedule permanent SSID config baseline update.
Create KB for internal support agents describing root cause and recommended temporary mitigations.
